content_of_post_to_answer: Do you brush your teeth before going to the dentist?
answer: I think the interesting part is that brushing before a dentist visit is less about cleaning your teeth and more about what it reveals: many people prepare for evaluation instead of showing the real condition. But dentists do not need a polished version; they need accurate information to help. I’ve explored this idea of why we hide problems before seeking help in more detail on my profile, if you’re curious. A good professional visit works best when you bring the reality, not the version you wish someone would see.
